shortDefinition.en: On an X-T5 with normal half-press operation, autofocus continually adjusts to changes in subject distance.
shortDefinition.zh-cn: 在 X-T5 正常半按快门操作时，自动对焦随主体距离变化持续调整。

en: Continuous autofocus does not freeze motion or guarantee that every tracked frame will be sharp.
zh-cn: 连续自动对焦不能冻结运动，也不保证每一张跟踪照片都清晰。

example.en: Use AF-C with an appropriate focus area when a person walks toward the camera.
example.zh-cn: 人物向相机走来时，可配合适当对焦区域使用 AF-C。

sources.title: Autofocus — FUJIFILM X-T5 Owner’s Manual
sources.supports: Continuous-AF adjustment for changes in subject distance.
